title: Roasted Eggplant and Tomato Orzo Pasta
style: Light, fresh, Mediterranean-inspired pasta with roasted eggplant, cherry tomatoes, herbs, and a bright lemon-garlic dressing
description: A light and fresh pasta dish featuring roasted eggplant and cherry tomatoes tossed with whole wheat orzo, fresh herbs, toasted pine nuts, feta, and a bright lemon-garlic dressing. Perfect for a healthy weeknight dinner.
steps: Preheat Oven: Set oven to 200°C. Line a large and a small rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roast Eggplant: Toss cubed eggplant with 30 ml olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on the large sheet. Roast on the middle rack for 25 minutes, tossing halfway through.
Roast Tomatoes: Toss halved tomatoes with 5 ml olive oil, salt, and pepper. Add to the upper rack of the oven after tossing eggplant. Roast for 12 minutes until tender and slightly wrinkled.
Cook Orzo: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook orzo until al dente, about 9 minutes. Reserve 240 ml pasta water, then drain and transfer to a large bowl.
Prepare Dressing: Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, red pepper flakes, and black pepper. Pour over warm orzo and toss to coat.

Combine Pasta & Veggies: Add roasted eggplant, tomatoes, feta, basil, parsley, and toasted pine nuts to the orzo. Toss to combine. If dry, add a few tablespoons of reserved pasta water or extra olive oil. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve: Serve immediately, warm or at room temperature.
tips: Make it vegan by omitting feta; add sliced Kalamata olives for salty punch.
Use gluten-free pasta instead of orzo if needed; cook according to package instructions.
Roast eggplant and tomatoes so they finish at the same time by timing the tomatoes later.
Reserve pasta cooking water to adjust consistency and keep pasta moist.
Serve with extra fresh herbs for a bright finish.
